component.name: Spotube
component.summary: Plugin powered, open source music streaming client

description.p: A cross-platform, extensible, open source music streaming platform. Bring your own music metadata, playlists and audio sources with plugins made by the community or by yourself.

ul.li: Plugin powered: supports any platform or custom music service through plugins
Community driven plugins for popular platforms, or create your own
Freely downloadable tracks with tagged metadata
Time synced lyrics regardless of plugin support
No telemetry, diagnostics or user data collection
Small size, low data usage and native performance

screenshot.caption: Browse music from the service your plugin connects to
Search tracks, albums, artists, playlists and users
